name: fraud-detector
intended_use: This model is intended to identify potentially fraudulent transactions based on transaction-related features. Its predictions are consumed by the fraud-detection system to flag transactions for further review.
training_data: The model was trained using the Week 4 card_activity feature group. Its coverage and limitations depend on the transactions and features represented in that training data, so it may not generalize well to patterns that are not represented.
limitations: This model should not be fully trusted for fraud patterns that cannot be distinguished using the available features. In particular, a simple amount-threshold classifier can miss fraudulent transactions with normal amounts and may incorrectly flag legitimate transactions with unusually high amounts.
ethical_considerations: A false positive can block a legitimate transaction and inconvenience or financially impact the customer. A false negative allows fraudulent activity to pass through, potentially causing financial loss to the customer or organization, so both types of errors have meaningful costs.
